name: Warcraft Scholar Study
body:
Associated Skill Profession (soldier) (Wis)

Basic Study Ability
War Training (Ex)

When you use inspiration on an attack roll, you expend only one point of inspiration instead of two. In addition, you may use your ranks in Profession (soldier) in place of your base attack bonus for the purpose of meeting all prerequisites for feats, prestige classes, and so on.

Associated Technique
Steadfast Technique (Ex)

You gain a +1 bonus to your CMD against all combat maneuvers attempted by the target of this ability. At 4th level and every 4 levels thereafter, this bonus increases by 1, to a maximum of +6 at 20th level.

Advanced Study Abilities
Combat Treatise

Prerequisite(s): War Training study ability, scholar level 2nd.

Your research into the art of war has uncovered a specific technique to improve your combat training. You gain a bonus feat, which must be a Combat feat. You must meet the prerequisites for whatever feat you select with this study ability.

Know Your Enemy (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Profession (soldier) 5 ranks, War Training study ability, scholar level 5th.

You apply your knowledge of other ancestries, creatures, and cultures to your efforts in combat. If you identify an opponent with the right Knowledge skill—for example, Knowledge (arcana) when facing dragons, Knowledge (religion) when facing undead, and so on—then you gain a +1 insight bonus to attack and damage rolls against that opponent for every 5 ranks you have in that Knowledge skill (minimum +1).

Knowledge Is Power (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Profession (soldier) 6 ranks, War Training study ability, scholar level 6th.

Your understanding of physical forces gives you power over them. You may substitute an Intelligence check anytime a Strength check is called for—such as on checks to break or lift objects. If you have the Agile Maneuvers feat, you may also use your Intelligence modifier instead of your Strength modifier when determining your CMB. If you have the Weapon Finesse feat, you may also use your Intelligence modifier instead of your Strength modifier on melee attack rolls with finesse weapons.

Principles of War (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): War Training study ability, scholar level 2nd.

You gain proficiency with medium armor, with shields (except tower shields), and with all martial weapons. If you have 10 or more ranks in Profession (soldier), you also gain proficiency with heavy armor.
